claims.evidence: The witness identifies the console as an Xbox One; the seller's model name is non-standard and ambiguous.
FC 26 is not a released title; the witness saw a football game but the full library and ownership type are not confirmed.
The witness report mentions numerous stickers on the top casing, which indicates a non-pristine exterior.
Internal condition and the integrity of warranty seals cannot be confirmed via photos.
Thermal performance and fan noise cannot be assessed through static observations.
While some cables are connected, there is no proof that every port has been tested and is functional.
The witness saw one wireless controller, but the seller's use of the plural 'pads' suggests more are included.
No receipt was shown or mentioned in the witness's observations.
